author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell reacts to a clip involving Benjamin Netanyahu and argues that it exposes a wider problem with media power — the ability of powerful interests to shape narratives, destroy reputations and influence what people believe. He connects it to his broader criticism of corrupt institutions and asks what happens when telling uncomfortable truths puts you against the people who control the story.
